Authors: Marta Silva, Andre Bouchard
Year: 2022
Deposited: 2023-04-11 by the Forecast Verification Unit

Verification Workflows for Operational Forecasting
A technical report of the Forecast Verification Unit, deposited alongside the item above.
Report DOI: 10.5555/synth.2023.611

Abstract
This report documents the operational workflow used to verify ensemble forecast products.
